topic: Gravity and Friction Effects on Motion
key_concepts: Gravity is an unseen force that pulls objects toward each other
Earth's gravity pulls objects toward the ground and keeps them on the ground
Objects tossed upward fall back down because of gravity
Greater surface area of a falling object increases air resistance
All objects with mass exert gravitational force; greater mass gives greater gravitational
Gravity slows objects moving upward and speeds up objects falling downward
Friction is a force produced when two surfaces rub against each other
Friction slows moving objects and prevents stationary objects from moving
Smooth surfaces produce less friction than rough surfaces
Brakes use friction to slow and stop vehicles; wet roads reduce friction
Road signs and traffic signals help regulate traffic and reduce road accidents
